stories.title: Binance resumes withdrawals following $6.3 billion breach
stories.take: The evening turn in the record hack: Binance has resumed withdrawals and says it has now covered 95% of the stolen assets.

stories.title: OpenAI might rebrand its data centers as ‘AI compute campuses’
stories.take: Data centers are deeply unpopular, so OpenAI is reportedly trying a friendlier name — ‘AI compute campuses’ — for the same massive builds.

stories.title: Parents of woman who died of seizure after ChatGPT misguidance sue OpenAI
stories.take: A woman died from a seizure after ChatGPT gave her a schedule to taper her anti-seizure medication; her parents are now suing OpenAI.

stories.title: Judge allows NAACP lawsuit over xAI data center pollution to move forward
stories.take: A judge let the NAACP's Clean Air Act suit against xAI over its data center pollution proceed — another legal front for the AI buildout.

stories.title: Apple CEO says the company doesn’t ‘want to ship AI for AI’s sake’
stories.take: Apple's new CEO defended its slower AI pace with a clear line: the company doesn't want to ship AI just for AI's sake.

stories.title: Data centers are now a midterm issue, even in Brooklyn
stories.take: Five days before Election Day, every conversation at a Brooklyn midterm gathering kept circling back to AI and data centers — the issue is now retail politics.

stories.title: How a small Wisconsin city scuttled a secretive $1.6bn datacenter project
stories.take: A small Wisconsin city quietly killed a secretive $1.6B datacenter project — a template other towns fighting undisclosed builds are studying.

stories.title: Chatbots Are Leading Hikers Astray, With Dangerous Consequences
stories.take: Wired warns that outsourcing trip planning to AI chatbots is sending hikers into the backcountry with bad information — and potentially deadly results.

stories.title: If smart glasses take off, I predict a new golden age for the billboard
stories.take: If smart glasses lift our gaze off our phones, Creative Bloq predicts a new golden age for the billboard — outdoor becomes the screen people actually look up at.

stories.title: From Pepsi Man to WendyQuest, why are brands making video games again?
stories.take: Brands are making games again, from Pepsi Man nostalgia to Wendy's pixel-art RPG WendyQuest — playable worlds are back in the media mix.

stories.title: "I’ve ignored most advice and learned by fire": 5 Questions with Christopher Glass
stories.take: Production designer Christopher Glass on ignoring most advice, learning by fire, and living with imposter syndrome.

stories.title: Are you team Apple or Samsung in the folding phone era?
stories.take: As Apple's iPhone Duo shows cracks in the facade, Creative Bloq asks whether Samsung's Galaxy Z Fold is still the foldable to beat.

stories.title: How to animate your drawings in Procreate the easy way
stories.take: A quick, practical Procreate walkthrough that brings a drawing to life in seconds — useful craft, no AI shortcut.

stories.title: Curry's ankle-breaker on Luka highlights Warriors' stunning 25-point comeback
stories.take: Final: Warriors 112, Lakers 95. Curry's theatrical 31 points — capped by an ankle-breaker on Luka — powered a stunning 25-point comeback win.

stories.title: Wemby scores season-best 43 points on career-high 34 shots
stories.take: Wembanyama launched a career-high 34 shots for a season-best 43 points as the Spurs beat the Timberwolves 121–111.

stories.title: Holmgren (knee) out 8-10 weeks; Thunder reconsider Agbaji, sources say
stories.take: Chet Holmgren is out 8–10 weeks with a knee injury, the third major Thunder loss this week after Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace.

stories.title: Jeanie Buss accuses siblings of 'cloak and dagger' tactics in Lakers' family saga
stories.take: Jeanie Buss accused her siblings of a 'cloak and dagger' campaign against her in court filings, as the fight over their Lakers shares drags on after the $12.5B sale.

stories.title: OKC declines option for oft-injured ex-lottery pick Topic
stories.take: OKC declined Nikola Topic's option for next season, making the oft-injured former lottery pick a free agent next summer.

stories.title: Hawks' Flemings suspended one game for elbowing Pelicans' McGowens in head
stories.take: The NBA suspended Hawks guard Kingston Flemings one game for intentionally elbowing Pelicans guard Bryce McGowens in the head.

stories.title: Thunder's $500 million problem: Execs on what they could -- and should -- do
stories.take: With two season-altering injuries, Windhorst and MacMahon take the league's pulse on what OKC could — and should — do about its $500M problem.

stories.title: 2026 MLB Gold Glove winners: Pete Crow-Armstrong wins second honor, Red Sox and D-backs lead with three each
stories.take: Gold Gloves are settled: Pete Crow-Armstrong won his second, and the Red Sox and Diamondbacks led with three winners each on Sunday night.

stories.title: Astros' Walker, Braves' Olson win 4th Gold Gloves; Red Sox's Abreu gets his 3rd
stories.take: First basemen Christian Walker and Matt Olson each won a fourth Gold Glove, while Boston's Wilyer Abreu took the fielding honor for a third straight year.

stories.title: Padres decline options on Pivetta, Giolito, Canning; exercise option on Hart
stories.take: Option day in San Diego: the Padres declined Nick Pivetta, Lucas Giolito and Griffin Canning, and exercised their option on Kyle Hart.

stories.title: After 7-2 season, Whitlock's $8.25 million option exercised by Red Sox
stories.take: Boston exercised Garrett Whitlock's $8.25M option for 2027 after his 7–2 season with a 1.72 ERA, keeping him out of free agency.

stories.title: Astros turn to Cardinals exec Flores as new GM
stories.take: Houston hired Cardinals executive Randy Flores as its new general manager.

stories.title: Mets legend Jerry Koosman dies at 83: Pitcher helped New York win 1969 World Series
stories.take: Jerry Koosman, the lefty who helped the 1969 Miracle Mets win the World Series, has died at 83; the Mets retired his No. 36 in 2021.

stories.title: Spain train crash: US, Japan and Canada citizens among dead, authorities say
stories.take: Spain's high-speed train collision killed 69 people, including four U.S. citizens and others from Canada, Japan, Argentina, Mexico, Tunisia and the Czech Republic — one of Europe's deadliest rail disasters this century.

stories.title: All 9 people aboard a jet that crashed in Florida have died, transportation secretary says
stories.take: All nine people aboard the business jet that crashed in Florida have died, the transportation secretary confirmed.

stories.title: Democrat Haley Stevens endorses Abdul El-Sayed’s Republican rival Mike Rogers
stories.take: On the eve of the midterms, Rep. Haley Stevens — who lost the Michigan Democratic Senate primary to Abdul El-Sayed — endorsed his Republican rival Mike Rogers, drawing party backlash over a 'betrayal.'

stories.title: Judge dismisses Trump attempt to block Alaska Senate race results if Republican loses
stories.take: A judge tossed the Trump-backed suit to block Alaska Senate certification if Dan Sullivan loses; Sullivan himself says he will accept the results.

stories.title: Connecticut senator Chris Murphy hospitalized after stroke
stories.take: Sen. Chris Murphy was hospitalized after a stroke at his son's hockey game; his office says he is responding well and expected to make a full recovery.

stories.title: Justice Department urges sanctions for database analysis critical of its noncitizen voting claims
stories.take: The Justice Department is urging sanctions over a database analysis that undercut its noncitizen voting claims — more than 40% of the names on its list were not on California's voter rolls.

stories.title: WATCH: Trump rallies in Iowa as part of final push before Election Day
stories.take: Trump rallied in Iowa in the final push before Election Day, as early voting totals headed toward 50 million nationwide.

stories.title: Shootings over Halloween weekend leave at least 6 dead and dozens injured across U.S.
stories.take: Halloween weekend gun violence left at least six dead and dozens injured across U.S. nightlife districts, including four dead and 15 injured in Dallas alone.

stories.title: Mayoral candidates Bass and Raman crisscross L.A. on final weekend before the election
stories.take: Bass and Raman crisscrossed L.A. on the final weekend, trading veiled shots at church and campaign stops in a mayoral race now in a dead heat.

stories.title: From an LGBTQ+ rally to Trunk or Treat, Becerra and Hilton barnstorm California hoping to be next governor
stories.take: With Tuesday's election barreling in, Becerra and Hilton barnstormed California from an LGBTQ+ rally to Trunk or Treat in a governor's race that stayed sedate until the end.

stories.title: Woman killed by LAPD patrol car responding to Halloween party call
stories.take: A woman was killed late Saturday by an LAPD patrol car responding to a backup call at a large Halloween party in the San Fernando Valley.

stories.title: Massive sewage main break prompts closure of all coastal waters off Long Beach
stories.take: A sewage main break spilling thousands of gallons closed all open coastal swimming areas, bays and lagoons off Long Beach.

stories.title: 3 days trapped in a drain pipe -- officers rescue man in Riverside
stories.take: Officers rescued a man who had been trapped for three days in an 18-inch drain pipe in Riverside.

stories.title: California Botox doctor used $45 million in Medicare money to fund her lavish lifestyle, feds say
stories.take: A California doctor convicted of billing for Botox injections never provided used $45M in Medicare money to fund a lavish lifestyle, federal prosecutors say.
